Instructions for Use
Device description: The Zephyr Neuromodulation System is a sacral neuromodulation system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Information
The Zephyr Neuromodulation System is MR Conditional. A person with the Zephyr Neuromodulation System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Zephyr Neuromodulation System
Device Configuration Therapy OFF
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 and 3 Tesla
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 1,900 gauss/cm
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 100 T/m/s per axis
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions Maximum Whole-Body SAR 0.4 W/kg; head averaged SAR of 0.4 W/kg
Scan Duration Scan for up to 30 minutes. Followed by a wait time of 30 minutes.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
